wrong: Node strays taken as an assumed budget (20 pF a node), so z read 1.31
rule: Take strays from the models' field solves, as nodes; the requirement is the node-total ratio (≥ ≈ 2.4 for z ≥ 1); as built z is 1.058 / 1.031

wrong: Varicap κ taken from the 2-D deck (7.47)
rule: Size the varicaps from 3-D field solves only (κ 3.51 as built)

wrong: The ideal gain read as the efficiency; the disc machine's η 0.386 / ≈ 0.50 applied to the tube
rule: The diode doubler's transfers are lossless and the pump's power ends as heat in the clamps (the equalization principle, locked); the disc machine's η does not apply
source: rebuild/README.md, lessons table L3; CONVENTIONS.md working rule; synthesis/synthesis-plan.md

wrong: The model's need for a seed read as the machine's
rule: The designer's four-diode build starts unaided, dry or humid, or with a rubbed PVC tube: record the experiment as data; the bench arbitrates
source: rebuild/README.md, lessons table L4; synthesis/core-engine-spec.md rec. 5 (N11)

wrong: Any seed taken to start the ideal model
rule: A seed that excites only the decaying mode does not start the ideal model

wrong: Measurement left out of the model: the paper's 82 pF probes dropped the predicted z from 1.372 to 1.154
rule: The bench's dividers must be in the S1 model
source: rebuild/README.md, lessons table L6; sim/queiroz-matrix-findings.md finding 2

wrong: Ca = Cb on five gaps (480.5 pF, 1.07 of the solved C_max) against the 1.1 C_max rule
rule: The sixth Ca gap (495 pF, 1.1 C_max) is DECIDED; node 1 at both column ends
source: rebuild/README.md, lessons table L7; synthesis/tube-spec.md A.8 (N2); docs/ledger/DCCREG-design-ledger.md §6 item 55

wrong: Ten electrical margins sit under 1.25, among them creepage, film, corona and the hot gel
rule: A margin under the bench's 1.25 hold-off criterion is a FAIL and is flagged, never carried silently

wrong: f2 (108–117 Hz) and a bearing frequency (108.3 Hz) sit under the pumps' 120 Hz; the frame was never checked (≈ 13 Hz)
rule: Check every mode, the frame's included, against the pumps' 120 Hz excitation
source: rebuild/README.md, lessons table L9; synthesis/retainer-spec.md (N6, N7)

wrong: The inner air runs +4.8–5.1 K against a +5 K limit
rule: Carry the inner air's rise against its +5 K limit as a stage check

wrong: The synthesis left hand figures without a script
rule: Every number needs a script (CLAUDE.md guardrail 4)

wrong: The Phase 2 commutator's wiring interface left unstated
rule: State the commutator's wiring interface from the start

wrong: The beads were sized in local boxes filled with gel and never put back in the hub, so the record's null missed their 7 %
rule: Solve what is built: model the geometry as drawn (the drawing's grooves bring the PEEK to the beads)

wrong: The rotor schematic drew no bypass and quoted only the unbypassed A-turns
rule: Draw PROPOSED parts dashed, and quote both A-turn ranges

wrong: A / B naming, which AH coil sits in which branch, and the winding sense were unrecorded
rule: Side A below in the record; the winding rule of sim/ah_winding.py

wrong: Superseded documents and figures read as the record (hub-locked figure, core-field / core-null findings, commutator-design, gap-topology-of-record)
rule: Mark a superseded document with a superseded banner and retitle it

wrong: The frozen list named charge-pump-synth-live.html and schematic.svg at the root; they live in tools/
rule: Frozen-list entries name the files' real paths, and the check prints 0

wrong: Creepage quoted as a voltage (the Ca / Cb mounts "need 5.7–7.5 kV of creepage")
rule: Creepage is a length: 40 mm on PTFE or 80 mm on G10 here; no mount bridges two adjacent plates

wrong: The record's solids labelled the shaft halves and flanges "steel" against the preset's non-magnetic
rule: Label materials as the preset records them: austenitic stainless, non-magnetic (μ_r ≤ 1.05)

wrong: The record's solids drew C1 and C2 in phase (every vane at rot 0), against the circuit's antiphase
rule: The solids follow the circuit's phasing: side B's stator vanes turned half a pitch (30°)

wrong: sim/stack_sizing.py's docstring had each stack "starting and ending on a stator vane"
rule: Each stack ends on a rotor vane beside the first Ca plate

wrong: The parts' first cut mounted the node-1 plates on conductive spacer rings on the sleeve
rule: Insulating mounts: conductive rings raise node 1's stray to 105 pF and take z with the chains to 1.008

wrong: DCCREG-UTR-101's data row takes the neck's knee at a stacking factor of 1 (0.225 mWb)
rule: State the stacking factor (0.90 [RH], knee 0.211 mWb); the drawing's row stays until the designer settles the strip

wrong: The record's rotor wiring crosses the hub-face bearings' counter-rotor spiders, which only the shaft passes
rule: Every lead runs on a path the layout provides; none crosses a counter-rotor spider

wrong: The magnetic pump's leads cross the Ca|reluctance spiders, unrouted
rule: Route every lead; PROPOSED: an 8 mm bore in each shaft half to the reluctance bay

wrong: The layout's envelopes are smaller than the capacitor candidates' real bodies (Ø21 × 28 / × 31; modules 44 / 47 mm over a 42 mm zone)
rule: Lay out with the real parts' envelopes

wrong: The doubler capacitors' mounts were left undrawn ("connection and mounts not drawn")
rule: Draw every part's mount; no support touches two adjacent plates (PROPOSED: two combs on their own posts)

wrong: Drawn part by part, the drive's first cut did not close: a seat that cannot carry its load, a gear that cannot reach its hub, bearings the case cannot hold, a bell over the belt's land, a pulley's flanges the catalogue part lacks
rule: Draw a first cut part by part, and check each seat's load path, each fit and each catalogue dimension, before it enters the record
source: docs/ledger/DCCREG-design-ledger.md §6 item 74; docs/drive-gear-belt.md §5, §8; drawings DRV-100 to DRV-190

wrong: The first cut's choke outline (84 × 70 × 59 mm) is the core and the winding's build only
rule: An outline includes the bobbin (1.0 mm wall, 1.5 mm flanges) and 1 mm past the build: 84 × 70 × 61

wrong: The schematics lagged the studies: parts chosen by a study drawn as "not chosen", its resistors missing, a figure predating the layout
rule: Redraw a schematic by its script when a study changes its parts; PROPOSED parts in amber with their candidates named

wrong: The ND7 / ND8 label positions break the A / B mirror (ND8 about 157 off)
rule: Node labels mirror with their pair; verify ND8's placement in the next rev

wrong: The doubler and commutation symbols are raw primitives, not blocks with named terminals, so a per-symbol trace is not robust
rule: Draw components as blocks with attributed terminals, so a tracer resolves every edge

wrong: The island's face count is not annotated on the DXF (single-face ~471 pF against the model's 648 pF)
rule: Annotate per face on the next DXF rev

wrong: General geometrical tolerances cited to ISO 2768-2, which is withdrawn
rule: Cite ISO 22081:2021 for general geometrical specifications
source: docs/brief-drafting-infra-phase0.md step 3, from the plan report's defect table (the report is not in the repo)

wrong: IEC 60664-1 used as the creepage and clearance basis above its scope
rule: IEC 60664-1 is out of scope above 1.5 kV DC; state another basis there
source: docs/brief-drafting-infra-phase0.md step 3, from the plan report's defect table (the report is not in the repo)

wrong: The surface-texture acceptance rule not stated per ISO 21920
rule: Apply ISO 21920's acceptance rule (the clause to be cited when verified)
source: docs/brief-drafting-infra-phase0.md step 3, from the plan report's defect table (the report is not in the repo)

wrong: ISO 128-2 line weights applied as if verified
rule: Treat the ISO 128-2 line weights as [RH] until verified against the standard
source: docs/brief-drafting-infra-phase0.md step 3, from the plan report's defect table (the report is not in the repo)

wrong: The KiCad version unpinned (9 against 10)
rule: Pin KiCad's major version; the rebuild's schematics are KiCad 10.0.6
source: docs/brief-drafting-infra-phase0.md step 3, from the plan report's defect table (the report is not in the repo); rebuild/kicad/kicad-findings.md
